reviews.author: Adam Rodgers
reviews.text: 100% recommend!!! Should have gone to Got Moles first.  16 years never having moles and this past summer one shows up.  Manages to destroy my backyard in a matter of 2 months.  I reached out to my regular exterminator service and they said they would take care of it.  After 3 weeks, no progress, in fact it was getting worse.  Called Got Moles and they came out that day to asses the situation.  2 days later they had traps set and in less then 24 hours they got the mole.  Don’t waste your time going to someone that does a lot of things ok, rather go straight to the experts!!!

reviews.author: Derek Smith
reviews.text:
These are a great bunch of people.
I have the worst neighborhood for moles.  Too many renters around so yards are not maintained.  I am an owner so I like my yard nice.  Got Moles helps sooo much by dealing with the underground devil footed blind rats.
If you are getting mounds and tunnels call GOT MOLES to help get control.

Joseph Irwin
reviews.text:
The absolute best. I'd give this business more stars if it was a option.

We have a small yard near Olympia but moles absolutely destroyed it, front and back. Tried everything. Traps. Stuff for the holes, stuff for the grass... Nothing worked.

Called this company up and the sent out one of the nicest people I have met in ages -- Luke LaVergne. Just a great guy through and through and a total professional, too.

He caught the moles and made very sure the yard was completely clear before pulling his traps. Grass is already growing back and the yards are returning to normal.
